title: Wild 9
synopsis: Shiny Entertainment’s PlayStation platformer — retained as a late-nineties Interplay action holding on pressed optical disc.

catalog.mediumForm: Pressed optical disc · PlayStation retail edition

custody.physical: Complete in box: case, pressed disc, manual, and original cover insert
custody.condition: Complete in box. Light shelf wear consistent with age. Preserved as a playable reference copy.

curatorNotes:
Wild 9 is a PlayStation platformer from the same Shiny Entertainment and Interplay circle that had already shaped mid-nineties console action elsewhere. On this shelf it stands apart from the Sony-published RPG line and from the licensed shooters already filed — a third-party action object whose hook is the Rig, not a gunslinger motif or a survival-horror town.

The filing is not an argument that the game was widely remembered. It is custody of a pressed Interplay release from 1998, when the Original PlayStation catalog was dense enough that distinctive platformers could vanish into the secondary market without leaving a digital fallback on this hardware.

Kept with the closing Original PlayStation group, Wild 9 widens what the platform collection can show: not only first-party RPGs and survival horror, but the stranger third-party action discs that shared the same black-disc retail channel.
collectionNotes:
Acquired in August 2026 while completing the Original PlayStation shelf.

The retained copy is the North American PlayStation edition published by Interplay (SLUS-00425). It remains complete in box with manual and cover insert, and is kept as the reference copy for this filing.

Dedicated artifact views of the individual copy have not yet been filed; the gallery below is held open for that documentation.

preservation.playableOn: Sony PlayStation; compatible North American PlayStation hardware
preservation.compatibility: Pressed for North American PlayStation consoles. The retained disc remains the primary access copy.
preservation.concerns: Optical-disc aging and surface damage remain the principal risks. The disc is stored upright in its original case under stable, dry conditions; printed materials remain housed with the copy.
preservation.knownRevisions: North American and European PlayStation releases in September 1998, developed by Shiny Entertainment and published by Interplay (North America: SLUS-00425). A Japanese release followed later under Sony Computer Entertainment.
preservation.availability: The original physical edition is out of print and circulates through the secondary market. No current digital edition replaces this reference copy.
